clips.caption: Four unseen test shapes dropped from 12-15 cm (2 s at 24 Hz): an elastic dinosaur (E = 1 MPa) lands, bounces and keeps its shape (0.5 mm non-rigid change, tilts 15 degrees), a thin elastic plank, a sand block spreads from 15 to 53 cm across, and a plasticine block (E = 10 kPa) tips onto its side (height 7.1 to 3.9 cm) with little deformation (2.2 mm).

An elastic shape; a patch of its material points is driven (113 states, 4.7 s at 24 Hz).

Two grippers fold the shoulders of a T-shirt (test garment; 6,022 cloth points of the 8 mm subset): they grasp the collar edge, lift it to 13 cm and lay it about 14 cm over the body (36% of the cloth moves more than 10 cm). 30 s recorded at 30 Hz, exported every 3rd state (10 Hz).
The same two-arm fold on a jacket (test garment; 6,650 cloth points): the largest folded share of the test set (40% of the cloth moves more than 10 cm).

One gripper folds one end of a pair of pants back over the garment (test garment; 5,322 cloth points of the 8 mm subset): it lifts the end to 14 cm and lays it about 15 cm back (11% of the cloth moves more than 10 cm). 30 s recorded at 30 Hz, exported every 3rd state (10 Hz).

Both grippers fold one side of a four-panel skirt over onto itself (test garment; 5,383 cloth points of the 8 mm subset): they lift its edge to 14 cm and lay it about 15 cm across (21% of the cloth moves more than 10 cm), and the skirt's extent along the fold shrinks from 61 to 45 cm. 30 s recorded at 30 Hz, exported every 3rd state (10 Hz).
A rod pushes a 6.8 cm rigid cube 11.5 cm while the cube turns 44 degrees (40 recorded states; the corpus stores no clock).
The rod pushes near a corner: the cube turns 100 degrees while moving 9.7 cm (40 recorded states, clock unknown).
A Franka Panda gripper (RL policy) pushes a teapot 18 cm across the table: contact at frame 4, the teapot moves during frames 5-12 and turns about 29 degrees (21 states, 1 s at 20 Hz).
clips.split: test (validation objects: new pushes on seen shapes)

clips.caption: A Panda gripper pushes a cup 27 cm and turns it 55 degrees (27 states, 1.3 s at 20 Hz).
clips.split: test (validation objects: new pushes on seen shapes)

clips.caption: The Panda gripper comes down on a held-out object (asset 7496, about 6.4 x 9.5 x 4.0 cm), closes on it and lifts it 40 cm: it leaves the table at 1.10 s and is still rising at the last state (the whole recorded episode: 40 states, 1.95 s at 20 Hz).

The Panda gripper carries a held object (asset 6665, about 13.0 x 15.6 x 14.4 cm) down 16 cm and sets it on the table 11 cm to the side by 0.60 s, then holds it: the fingers stay closed on it to the end of the recorded episode (40 states, 1.95 s at 20 Hz).

In a cluttered scene of 8 objects the Panda gripper picks a pill bottle, lifts it 27 cm (frame 114), carries it and puts it down 36 cm away at the small frying pan (task text: 'Place the pill_bottle_0092 on the small_frying_pan_0018'); the 7 distractors stay put (at most 0.1 mm). 327 states, 16.3 s at 20 Hz.

A Sharpa hand reorients a held-out object, turning it about 145 degrees within 1.25 s (the clip shows states 280 to 400 of 400, 20 Hz).
